jobs.prompt:
Create a polished character-specific DESIGN REVIEW PRESENTATION SHEET for the Korean retirement board game '연금로드'. Use case: ui-mockup + stylized-concept. This is a new mockup, not a screenshot of a released feature. Input image 1 is the authoritative character identity reference: retain recognizable silhouette, color blocks, facial features and signature accessory. Input image 2 is the approved A-1 rendering style reference ONLY: soft matte premium clay-like 3D, warm bank-service friendliness, mild depth and studio light. Do NOT copy the other characters from image 2. Input image 3 is current board UI context: retain flat rounded pastel tiles, small dark green typography, white/mint backgrounds. Remove all existing fox/animal player tokens from the mockup and use only the requested mascot repeated at different sizes.

Make ONE landscape 1536x1024 design sheet, clean white, generous airy margins, aligned editorial grid. Restrained contemporary Korean bank app visual design, deep green #176B49 text/buttons, mint #EDF6EF, sky #EFF6FB, pale peach and cream. Character is dimensional, UI is flat and crisp. No dark thick cartoon outlines around the new 3D character. All panels show THE SAME character and same identity.

Fixed layout: header across top with small '연금로드 · 캐릭터 디자인 검토' and the large character name below. Main two equal panels underneath, separated by 32px whitespace:
LEFT panel headed '선택창'. A tall rounded white character card on a pale mint backing. Show the requested character as a LARGE full-body 3D mascot waving gently, feet fully visible, subtle contact shadow. Name beneath, green pill '선택됨', and a bottom green button reading '이 캐릭터로 선택'. This card occupies most of the left panel. A discreet note below reads '외형만 변경 · 투자자성향과 별개'.
RIGHT panel headed '게임판 위'. Show a close-up of an actual flat top-down 3-by-3 section of the current game board, with spacious rounded-square pastel cells, tiny outline icons and small labels, not a whole large board. A compact miniature of the SAME full-body mascot occupies the TOP HALF of the central mint square, on a thin ivory oval pawn base with green rim. The square's small label '예금' stays fully unobstructed below the pawn; adjacent small labels '시장 뉴스', '생활 사건' readable. Pawn must visibly fit within a single tile without covering neighboring labels. In empty space below the board crop show three miniature standalone pawn poses in an evenly spaced row: upright calm, one foot slightly lifted as hopping movement, gentle wave as arrival. Below them exact small captions '대기' '이동' '도착'. No exaggerated motion blur or extra limbs. Retain face recognition at small size, no handheld props. A small pair of real white dice with deep-green pips can sit beside the board to indicate boardgame play, not plain numeric dice replacements.
Bottom footer: small '검토용 시안 · 게임 반영 전'.
Prioritize clear faithful mascot design and real useful game UI appearance over decorative clutter. No bank logo, no promotional claims, no money piles, no performance or risk labels, no other characters, no watermark, no crowded layouts. Korean text must be correct, simple modern sans-serif.

CHARACTER NAME EXACTLY: '올리'. Sheet number 01. CHARACTER IDENTITY: Lime yellow-green baby dinosaur, rounded pear-shaped head/body, large white oval eyes with warm brown pupils, cream circular belly, one small white bump on top of head, olive small nose, wide friendly mouth, tiny rounded hands and feet. No clothes. Preserve the exact species-neutral cartoon silhouette of official Ally, never a generic reptile.
